digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow - pytest job
propositions: The macOS pytest (macos-latest, py3.13) job default-suite step takes 15.4 minutes of an 18.6 minute total due to coverage.py tracing via --cov flags, despite coverage output being unused on macOS
Coverage floor enforcement via fail_under=70 is identically gated three times on ubuntu cells running the same test selection, making macOS coverage collection duplicate work
macOS runner concurrency is capped at 4 concurrent jobs, causing later changes to queue 6.7-8.4 minutes waiting for available runners, converting a 21 minute run into 41-47 minute wall-clock time

The --cov and --cov-report flags must be made conditional on matrix.os in the workflow to remove the coverage tracing cost from macOS while preserving platform-compat testing (flock/mkdir lock, gtimeout) and ubuntu coverage enforcement
